architecture_principles: Preserve aspose.org practical behavior, not legacy layout.
Keep standalone repo cleaner through adapters, registries, tests, and compatibility shims.
Do not couple standalone execution to in-repo Hugo content; use external content-root and redirected output-root contracts.
Add wrappers only when needed for compatibility or discoverability.
Do not write to aspose.org/content during verification.

capability_designs.target_design: Normalize this skill through the external content repo adapter so it works with standalone paths and never assumes in-repo Hugo content.

workstreams.target: Inspect the aspose.org and standalone skill contracts, preserve required user outcomes, keep standalone wording only where behavior is equivalent or better, and add regression tests.

workstreams.target: Replace website-local assumptions with a documented `CONTENT_REPO_PATH`/config adapter, clone-cache resolver, output-root override, and metrics dry-run policy.

workstreams.name: Dependency Port Or Adapter Layer
workstreams.target: Port required helper scripts/modules when they are skill-system behavior; otherwise add compatibility wrappers to clean standalone modules or document external content-repo responsibility.

workstreams.target: For prompt-only skills, define an explicit execution contract and add smoke tests or wrapper entrypoints for representative outcomes.
